subject: How to add values to a vector based off numericInput

messages.author: 544b331affe7cb21
messages.subject: How to add values to a vector based off numericInput
parts:
What I want is when a user enters a number into numeric input, for example 3, my vector will append 3 one's. So far my entire code looks like this:
library(shiny)
vec = c()
vec[1] = 1

ui<-fluidPage(
numericInput("amount", min = 0.0, max = 5.0, value = 3, step = 1, label = "amount"),
vec[1:2])
server<-(function(input, output, session) 
{
  observe({for (i in 1:input$amount)
    vec[i] <- 1})
})
shinyApp(server = server, ui = ui)

When I display vec it seems like the for loop never runs.

messages.subject: Re: How to add values to a vector based off numericInput
parts:
Ultimately I want to have a save data function like so:

savedata <- function(data) 
{
  #Write test data to test.aci
  write.table(data[1:length(vec)], "test.aci", row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE, append = FALSE, quote= FALSE)
}
ui<-fluidpage(
actionbutton("execute","save"))

server<-(function(input, output, session) 
{
values<-reactive({c(1,2)})
observeEvent(input$execute,
{savedata(values())})
}

Essentially I want the user to be able to select a numeric input and add one's to the vector based off their selection and then when I press the action button the savedata function will write the vector values into an aci file.

Thank you for your time!
